description: This file defines a set of simple permission-related methods for data resource management within the content application, including permission checks for viewing, creating, and updating data resources using a custom XML-based method definition schema in Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: genericDataResourcePermission
methods.description: Main permission service that delegates to specific permission checks based on mainAction parameter; checks whether the user has permission to view, create, or update data resources.

methods.name: viewDataResourcePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to view a specific data resource, performing base permission check and role permission check.

methods.name: createDataResourcePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to create a new data resource, including base permission check and role permission check.

methods.name: updateDataResourcePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to update an existing data resource, including ownership verification.
